v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Vide, Dómine, * afflictiónem meam, quóniam eréctus est inimícus meus.
text.en: O Lord, behold my affliction; * for the enemy hath magnified himself.

text.la: In tribulatióne * invocávi Dóminum, et exaudívit me in latitúdine.
text.en: I called upon the Lord * in my distress; and He answered me, and set me at large.

text.la: Iudicásti, Dómine, * causam ánimæ meæ, defénsor vitæ meæ, Dómine Deus meus.
text.en: O Lord, Thou hast pleaded the cause of my soul; * Thou hast redeemed my life, O Lord my God.

text.la: Pópule meus, * quid feci tibi, aut quid moléstus fui? Respónde mihi.
text.en: O My people, what have I done unto thee? * or wherein have I wearied thee? testify against Me.

text.la: Numquid rédditur * pro bono malum, quia fodérunt fóveam ánimæ meæ.
text.en: Shall evil be recompensed for good? * for they have digged a pit for My soul.

text.la: Fratres: Christus assístens Póntifex futurórum bonórum, per ámplius et perféctius tabernáculum non manu factum, id est, non huius creatiónis: neque per sánguinem hircórum aut vitulórum, sed per próprium sánguinem introívit semel in Sancta, ætérna redemptióne invénta.
text.en: But Christ, being come an high priest of the good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle not made with hand, that is, not of this creation: Neither by the blood of goats, or of calves, but by his own blood, entered once into the holies, having obtained eternal redemption.

v.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
v.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.

r.la: Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
r.en: And defend me from them that rise up against me.

text.la: Dicébat Iesus * turbis Iudæórum, et princípibus sacerdótum: Qui ex Deo est, verba Dei audit: proptérea vos non audítis, quia ex Deo non estis.
text.en: Jesus said * unto the multitudes of the Jews and unto the Chief Priests: He that is of God heareth God's words; ye, therefore, hear them not, because ye are not of God.

text.la: Quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus, famíliam tuam propítius réspice: ut, te largiénte, regátur in córpore; et, te servánte, custodiátur in mente.
text.en: We beseech thee, Almighty God, mercifully to look upon this thy family, that by thy great goodness they may be governed and preserved evermore, both in body and soul.
